# Courtroom Chronicles

> Indian court cases, explained in plain English. Courtroom Chronicles is an audio series that retells Indian court cases as stories, then breaks each one down: what happened, what the court decided, and the law behind it. Every episode has a page here with the case notes, so you can read, search and check the sources.

A podcast about landmark Indian court cases, told as stories in plain English. Each episode page has a summary, the case citation, key legal principles and links to listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube.

## Key pages
- [All episodes](https://naveenkoti.github.io/courtroom-chronicles/)
- [Sitemap](https://naveenkoti.github.io/courtroom-chronicles/sitemap.xml)

Not legal advice. Educational content only.
